name: Pixel-Clothing-Website
description: Pixel Clothing Website is a stylish, responsive web storefront designed for a fictional fashion brand specializing in pixel-art-inspired apparel. Built with modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, the site features:

paragraphs: Retro MC reimagines the traditional e-commerce shopping experience as a classic 8-bit RPG adventure. Instead of scrolling through a standard grid of products, users enter a "Merchant House," interact with the shopkeeper, and browse items through a gamified inventory UI. Built with Next.js and MongoDB, the application pairs robust full-stack architecture with a highly stylized, nostalgic frontend.

This project was built to demonstrate my skills in designing with code. Apart from the product photos of the tees, there are no image files behind the visuals: the riverside title scene, the shop interior, EJ the animated shopkeeper, the wooden frames and parchment scrolls, the icons, the cursors, and the logo are all drawn programmatically, pixel by pixel. A small custom pixel-art engine paints the scenes, procedural techniques (noise, dithering, seeded randomness) add texture, and CSS and canvas animation bring everything to life.
features: RPG Merchant Interaction: EJ, the shopkeeper, stands behind the counter as an animated pixel sprite: she breathes, blinks, waves when you arrive, talks while her typewriter dialogue plays, holds up the tee you pick, and…
Keeper's Inventory: A stylized UI where users "equip" clothing items to view their high-res pixel art, descriptions, and "passive stats" before adding them to their cart.

Everything Drawn in Code: Apart from the tee product photos, every visual is generated in code: both scenes, EJ, the UI frames, icons, cursors, the logo, and the favicon. A small pixel engine (src/lib/pixel) paints the…
Living Scenes: Pixel clouds drift over the riverside title screen, with twinkling stars, fireflies, and a flickering lantern; inside the shop, lamplight flickers and dust motes float.
Authentic Aesthetics: Pixel fonts (Depixel, Pixelify Sans, Jersey 10), pixel cursors, and 8-bit background audio with a persistent mute toggle.
